component.name: Tegami Mail
component.summary: A fast, private email client for GNOME

description.p: Tegami Mail is a desktop email client for GNOME, written in Rust with libadwaita. Your mail and credentials stay on your machine, remote content is blocked until you allow it, and there is no telemetry. It works with IMAP, POP3, JMAP and Microsoft 365, and with any server from iCloud to Proton Bridge to a Stalwart of your own.

ul.li: Several accounts, with Microsoft sign-in built in, Google through GNOME Online Accounts, or any account already set up in GNOME
Whole-mailbox sync and search, conversations across folders, and changes made on other devices synced back
Folders, filters, tags, smart folders and favorites, with Trash and Junk emptied by hand or on a schedule
Snooze, Undo Send, an Outbox for sends that fail, and printing
Rich or plain text, HTML signatures, templates, inline images, spell and grammar checking, and undo
Drafts, quote folding, and forwarding that keeps the attachments
Large files shared from your own Nextcloud, ownCloud, OpenCloud or Seafile server, OneDrive or Dropbox; a Send with Tegami Mail entry in GNOME Files
Each conversation as a column of cards, with message zoom and translation
OpenPGP signing, encryption and reading; DKIM, SPF and DMARC checked on arrival
Meeting invitations answered in place, read receipts, and one-click unsubscribe from list mail
An adaptive layout that follows the system's style, text size, language and clock
Swipe actions and single-key shortcuts, with a Gmail variant
Notifications with actions, and mail that keeps arriving with the window closed
GNOME Contacts, CardDAV address books and LDAP directories; passwords kept in the system keyring

description.p: The first release of Tegami Mail, a redesign of Hylki 1.46 that keeps its engine.

ul.li: Conversations as a column of cards, a calmer message list with short dates, tags as coloured chips
Preferences in five short pages, a new first-run assistant and Troubleshooting in the main menu
The reading pane beside the list, below it, or off
Folders kept on this computer, mail imported from Thunderbird or Evolution, and grammar checking while you write
Dates, text size and style follow the system
Complete in eleven languages
